Subject: MAP: Technical evaluation plan & next steps (Acme Corp)

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we're all aligned:

- Goal: Validate Redwood's inference economics and latency profile for your customer-facing summarization use case and decide on deployment model (Hosted vs Dedicated/Private).
- Proposed target close date for purchase decision: 2026-08-12 (we discussed early Aug).

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that includes a milestone for the Technical Evaluation Plan (see section 3). For the technical evaluation milestone we've sketched out owners, deliverables, success criteria, and dependencies — but would like your input on the success criteria and any internal constraints we should be aware of (e.g., corporate latency/SLA, cost limits, data residency).

Key asks from Acme for the tech eval:
1) Confirm the sample dataset / representative prompt set you want us to use (or drop a link to a shared folder).
2) Confirm latency & cost targets (we suggested draft targets below).
3) Confirm who from your engineering/security teams should join the kickoff and the best times next week.

Draft success criteria we propose (open to edit):
- Latency: p95 <= 150 ms for 512-token generation (at steady-state QPS typical for your traffic pattern).
- Cost: <= $0.018 per 1k tokens on average for the evaluated configuration.
- Quality: >= 85% pass rate on your acceptance prompts / rubric (we'll help set the rubric).

Model shortlist we recommend evaluating initially:
- Llama-2-70B-chat (quantized) — strong instruction following, will need GPU capacity.
- Mistral-instruct-7B — good cost/latency tradeoff for conversational tasks.
- RedModel-v1 (reduced param conv variant, Redwood-verified) — candidate for lowest latency.

Attachments: Acme_MAP_Draft_v1.docx, redwood_tech_eval_template.xlsx (tech eval template with test plan).

Proposed next steps:
- Sara/Tom: confirm dataset link and tech eval owner(s) (by EOD Tue 7/20).
- Redwood (Marissa & Dylan): share finalized MAP milestone and schedule kickoff with Eng by 7/21.
- Procurement: if procurement requires an initial SOW/PO, flag that so we can loop in Finance early.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the MAP if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Tom / Sara —

Per Tom's note, we've expanded the MAP milestone for the Technical Evaluation Plan. Summary below (full details in the attached tech eval template):

--- Technical Evaluation Plan (MAP milestone) ---
Milestone name: Technical evaluation plan and perf benchmark
Target completion: 2026-07-30 (internal evaluation) with a customer review week of 2026-08-02 to 2026-08-06. Decision target date in MAP: 2026-08-12.
Owners: Redwood (Marissa/Dylan) + Acme (Sara + Eng lead)
Deliverables:
- Baseline latency and cost benchmarks for shortlisted models under your representative workload.
- A 48-hour soak test at expected QPS, plus a 1-hour spike test.
- Quality evaluation using your prompt set and our acceptance rubric (we'll propose thresholds).
- Deployment guidance (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and estimated costs for each.
Success criteria (proposed):
- Latency: p95 <= 150 ms for 512-token responses at target concurrency.
- Cost: median token cost <= $0.018 per 1k tokens for the chosen configuration.
- Quality: >= 85% pass rate on customer acceptance prompts (per rubric).
Model shortlist: 
- Llama-2-70B-chat (quantized inference build) — candidate for highest quality.
- Mistral-Instruct-7B — candidate for best cost/latency tradeoff.
- Redwood-Convo-3B (quantized) — candidate for lowest latency on Dedicated nodes.

Dependencies / blockers:
- Access to a representative prompt set & sample data (Sara to share Drive link).
- SOC2 evidence & gov/regulatory checklist for any PII-related flows (if Private/VPC required).
- Procurement/PO timelines (Procurement to confirm whether an SOW/PO is required to schedule Dedicated capacity).

Evaluation methodology (high level):
1) Kickoff call with Eng to lock workload shape and QPS.
2) Baseline runs (single instance) to capture per-token latency.
3) Continuous-batching experiments (vary batch size, batching window).
4) Quantization profiles applied & compare accuracy/regression.
5) 48-hour soak at expected QPS, capture p50/p95/p99 and cost aggregation.

Immediate asks from Acme (action items):
- Sara: share sample prompts + dataset link (by Tue 7/20).
- Eng: join the kickoff call 7/21 09:00 PT.
- Procurement: flag any required PO/SOW timeline.

We'll populate the MAP with the above and circulate an updated version by EOD Monday 7/20. If you want Redwood to run an initial micro-benchmark prior to the kickoff (small subset of prompts), we can do that as well — let us know.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
